options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Goal Boss
options.doc: Choose a goal boss. Spooky goal will not include post-game levels & items.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez un chef de but. Objectif Spooky n'inclut pas les niveaux et les éléments après le jeu.

options.name: Gold Medal Checks
options.doc: Makes each gold time trial medal a check. Adds 23 or 36 checks depending on goal.

options.name: Level Randomizer
options.doc: Levels get randomized into the item pool instead of unlocking them with Golden Fruits or Keys.

options.name: Number of Starting Levels
options.doc:
If level_randomizer is enabled, you can choose how many levels you start with.
Does nothing if level_randomizer is disabled.

options.name: Move Randomizer
options.doc:
Movement abilities will get randomized into the item pool.
If level_randomizer is disabled, you will receive Butt Bounce at the start to prevent a restrictive start.

options.name: Moves to Randomize
options.doc:
If move_randomizer is enabled, you can choose which moves get randomized into the item pool.
Moves not listed are given at the start.

Note: It is recommended to start with Butt Bounce.

Does nothing if move_randomizer is disabled.

options.name: Move Randomizer Logic Difficulty
options.doc:
If move_randomizer is enabled, choose how difficult the logic will be. Does not reflect in-game difficulty selection.

Fairy Mode: Mostly intended logic. Some thinking required.
Adventure Mode: Mostly unintended logic. Includes difficult tricks, glitches, and restart/death abuse.
Anything goes: Unfun logic. Includes the hardest tricks and glitches.

options.name: Fruit Switches
options.doc: Adds fruit switches to the items pool. Disables fruit of that type until the respective switch is found.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des interrupteurs de fruits à la piscine d'articles. Désactive les fruits de ce type jusqu'à ce que l'interrupteur correspondant soit trouvé.

options.name: Starting Fruit Switches
options.doc:
Choose how many fruit switches are given at the start.

Does nothing if fruit switches are disabled.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez combien d'interrupteurs de fruits sont donnés au début.

Ne fait rien si les interrupteurs de fruits sont désactivés.

options.name: Exclude Goal Locations
options.doc:
Prevents important items from appearing in locations that require most/all goal items.
Includes goal level locations and Pac-Village mission with Spooky goal.

options.name: Pac-Dot Weight
options.doc: Chance that unfilled locations have Pac-Dots.
options.doc_fr: Il y a une chance que les lieux non remplis aient Pac-Dots.

options.name: Points Weight
options.doc: Chance that unfilled locations have Points.
options.doc_fr: Peut-être que les endroits non remplis ont des points.

options.name: Lives Weight
options.doc: Chance that unfilled locations have extra lives.
options.doc_fr: Il y a une chance que les lieux non remplis aient une vie supplémentaire.

options.name: Trap Weight
options.doc: Chance that unfilled locations have a trap.
options.doc_fr: Peut-être que les endroits non remplis ont un piège.
